description: This Java class 'JustOneInstance' checks if an instance of the application is already running by attempting to connect to a predefined port. If unable to connect, it starts a server socket to listen for subsequent instances, thus enforcing a single running instance pattern.

classes.name: JustOneInstance
classes.description: Utility class to ensure only one instance of the application runs at a time by checking and handling socket connections.

methods.name: isAlreadyRunning
methods.description: Checks if another instance is running by attempting to connect to the local port. Returns true if an instance is detected.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts a server socket in a new thread to listen for other instances starting, accepts and closes incoming connections.
